title: Record of an initial configuration
statement: Let $x$ be a Boolean input word, let $s$ be a nonnegative integer, let $q_0$ be a state, and let $\tau_0$ be a tag. The record of the initial configuration on $x$, with tag $\tau_0$, consists of a state field containing $q_0$, a position field containing the binary digits of $1$ in width equal to the bit width of $|x|+1$, and one field for each of the $k$ work tapes. Each work-tape field has $2s+1$ blank cells with its head mark at the central cell; the final field contains the tag $\tau_0$.
